description: HR-50 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) situated in the Hodal subdivision of the Palwal district. It operates under the jurisdiction of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and is responsible for vehicle registrations, issuing driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the region.
address: RLA-cum-SDM Office, Hassanpur Chowk, Hodal, Palwal District, Haryana
